display.purpose: OVERLOAD wordmark and session volume total. Two uses only.

label.purpose: All buttons, tabs, day selector pills. Always uppercase.

data.purpose: Weight and reps inputs. Never below 16px.

micro.purpose: Footer annotations, column headers, pill labels.

motion.name: progress-fill
motion.purpose: Progress bar width on set completion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Confirmation actions: AGREGAR, IMPORTAR, COPIAR. The only button that visually pops.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #f0f0f0; color: #0a0a0a; padding: 12px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d0d0d0; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Navigation and secondary actions. Disappears into the dark surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #cccccc; padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid #1e1e1e; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #111111; color: #f0f0f0; }

components.name: Day Selector Pill (Active)
components.description: Selected day in the horizontal day picker.
components.css: .ds-day-pill { background: transparent; color: #cccccc; padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid #1e1e1e; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 1px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; touch-action: manipulation; transition: transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-day-pill--active { background: #f0f0f0; color: #0a0a0a; border-color: #f0f0f0; } .ds-day-pill:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Data Input
components.description: Weight and reps number inputs. Center-aligned mono. Never below 16px.
components.css: .ds-input-data { background: #0f0f0f; border: 1px solid #1e1e1e; border-radius: 6px; color: #f0f0f0; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 16px; padding: 10px 8px; text-align: center; width: 100%; outline: none; } .ds-input-data::placeholder { color: #555555; } .ds-input-data:focus { border-color: #333333; }

components.name: Done Button (Default)
components.description: 44px circle. Marks a set as complete. Minimum touch target for gym use.
components.css: .ds-done-btn { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; border: 2px solid #444444; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; padding: 0; touch-action: manipulation; transition: background 0.2s ease-out, border-color 0.2s ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-done-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-done-btn--complete { background: #22c55e; border-color: #22c55e; color: #ffffff; font-size: 18px; }

components.name: RIR Pill
components.description: Severity-coded rating. 5 pills per row, flex:1. Color encodes athletic performance zone.
components.css: .ds-rir-row { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-rir-pill { flex: 1; border: 1px solid #333333; border-radius: 5px; padding: 8px 2px; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; background: transparent; color: #555555; cursor: pointer; text-align: center; touch-action: manipulation; transition: transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-rir-pill:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-rir-pill--selected { color: #ffffff; } .ds-rir-0.ds-rir-pill--selected { background: #ef4444; border-color: #ef4444; } .ds-rir-1.ds-rir-pill--selected { background: #f97316; border-color: #f97316; } .ds-rir-2.ds-rir-pill--selected { background: #eab308; border-color: #eab308; color: #000000; } .ds-rir-3.ds-rir-pill--selected { background: #22c55e; border-color: #22c55e; } .ds-rir-4.ds-rir-pill--selected { background: #6b7280; border-color: #6b7280; }

components.name: Exercise Card
components.description: The signature component. Groups all sets for one exercise. Border turns red on repeated RIR 0.
components.html:
Press Plano Máquina
compound · 180kg vol · Obj: 3×8@80kg
components.css: .ds-exercise-card { background: #111111; border: 1px solid #1e1e1e; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; } .ds-exercise-card--alarm { border-color: #7f1d1d; } .ds-exercise-name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: #f0f0f0; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-exercise-meta { font-size: 12px; color: #888888; } .ds-target { color: #3b82f6; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Session completion track. 5px height, gradient blue→green, transitions to solid green at 100%.
components.css: .ds-progress-track { height: 5px; background: #1a1a1a; border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 3px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3b82f6, #22c55e); transition: width 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-progress-fill--complete { background: #22c55e; }

narrative.overview:
OVERLOAD is a training log built like a powerlifting scoresheet. The interface takes its cues from the precision instruments athletes trust — stopwatches, scoring tablets, weight plates. Everything is dark, dense, and direct. Bebas Neue stamps identity like a scoreboard. DM Mono renders every datum with the flat authority of a measured result.

The palette is a near-black monolith. Color exists in exactly two registers: the neutral ink stack and a coded severity vocabulary for RIR and fatigue. When the done-button turns green, it means something. The system's restraint is the point.

What this system explicitly rejects: the motivational pastel UX of MyFitnessPal and Hevy. The SaaS dashboard template — Inter typeface, metric cards on white — is the anti-reference. Every decision starts from: does this serve the set log, or does it make the interface look like a productivity tool?
keyCharacteristics: Near-black monolith: five surface depths, zero decorative color
Bebas Neue (identity) + DM Mono (data): functional pairing with intentional contrast
Touch-first: all interactive elements ≥ 44×44px, spaced for single-hand gym use
Flat layering: depth via background steps, borders as the only elevation signal
Aggressive state: RIR 0 fires red across the entire card border, not a subtle icon

rules.name: The Monolith Rule
rules.body: The only saturated colors permitted are the semantic data vocabulary (RIR scale, done-state, target). No decorative use of any named color outside its defined semantic role.

rules.name: The No-Softening Rule
rules.body: Error states are aggressive by design. When RIR 0 fires twice, the entire card border turns #7f1d1d. The app does not soften bad training data with neutral warnings.

rules.name: The Mono Data Rule
rules.body: All numeric data entry and display uses DM Mono at ≥ 16px. Anything smaller loses legibility under gym lighting.

rules.name: The Bebas Ceiling
rules.body: Bebas Neue appears in exactly two contexts: the OVERLOAD wordmark and volume totals. Never in form labels, button copy, navigation, or data.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow on any component. If a component needs to appear above others, it uses position: fixed with a border — not a shadow.

dos: Do use DM Mono for all numeric data, labels, buttons, and form text.
Do use Bebas Neue exclusively for the OVERLOAD wordmark and volume totals.
Do keep all touch targets at ≥ 44×44px.
Do use the RIR color vocabulary consistently: 0=red, 1=orange, 2=yellow, 3=green, 4+=gray.
Do use border: 1px solid #1e1e1e as the primary depth signal. No box-shadow.
Do make error states aggressive: RIR 0 twice turns the entire card border #7f1d1d.
Do add touch-action: manipulation to all buttons to prevent double-tap zoom.
Do animate transform and opacity only — never width, height, or layout properties.
Do confirm actions with scale(0.97) on :active, transition: transform 120ms ease-out.
donts: Don't use box-shadow on any component. The system is flat by design.
Don't use MyFitnessPal-style colorful cards, muscle icons, achievement badges, or motivational copy.
Don't use SaaS dashboard patterns: sidebar navigation, Inter/Poppins typeface, metric card grids on white.
Don't use border and box-shadow together on the same element. Pick one.
Don't use border-radius greater than 12px on cards or containers.
Don't use Bebas Neue in buttons, form labels, inputs, or navigation text.
Don't introduce a new accent color without a defined semantic role.
Don't animate keyboard-initiated actions or actions repeated more than 10× per session.
Don't use transition: all — specify exact properties (transform, background, border-color, opacity).
Don't decorate inactive states with saturated color.
